findings.problem: 'organizing agent' is rendered व्यवस्थापक (administrator/manager), which names a different function from organising the catalogue; the same roster also lists a Manager agent, so the two roles read closer than the source makes them.
findings.suggestion: लाइब्रेरी को व्यवस्थित करने वाला एजेंट: … (or लाइब्रेरी का संयोजक एजेंट), rest unchanged

findings.problem: 'AI-isms' means AI-flavoured writing tells; the Hindi says 'AI-like artificial things', dropping the writing object, while every other criterion in that list is a property of the text.
findings.suggestion: …और AI जैसी बनावटी भाषा (or …और AI की पहचान देने वाली घिसी-पिटी बातें)

findings.problem: ड़ carries no nukta (ढूँढ़ता), against the hi style guide's binding nukta rule. The catalogue's only other use, ui.teamBridge.create.channel_description ('ढूँढकर'), has the same defect, so a fix should cover both.
findings.suggestion: खामियाँ ढूँढ़ता है — or the everyday खामियाँ खोजता है, which sidesteps the orthography

findings.problem: Fit: 25 cells vs 15 for 'Install to edit' (1.67x; 26 vs 15 characters). Not rendered in this audit, so this is a check to run, not an observed overflow: the label shares a shrink-0 header row with नई चैट and the key carries no maxCells hint. The pending label is shorter than this one, so the button does not grow when the install starts.
findings.suggestion: Keep if the header tolerates it; संपादन हेतु इंस्टॉल करें (23 cells) is the lever if it does not. Confirm on a rendered frame in the design round.

method.mechanical: node --test scripts/i18n/locale-parity.test.mjs in /Users/damian/lo-agents-i18n: baseline 44/44 pass; re-run with these two files copied verbatim into src/i18n/catalogues/hi/ -> 44/44 pass, including the hi cases (ships at least one message; defines each key in at most one namespace file; carries EVERY key of each namespace file it ships; names only keys the English source defines; preserves every ICU placeholder from the English source; is not an English stub). The copies were then removed; git status is clean.
method.character_checks: python utf-8 read: NFC round-trip for all 14 values; no BOM; no ZWSP/ZWNJ/ZWJ; no NBSP or double spaces; no leading/trailing space; every description ends with danda (।) and none has a space before it; installing ends with U+2026 (not three dots); key sets and key order identical to English; JSON parses; tab-indented, trailing newline, matching the repository's catalogue bytes style.
method.placeholders_cldr: no ICU arguments, plurals or selects appear in these 14 English values, so CLDR category coverage is not exercisable here (declared n/a, not silently skipped).
method.tokens: Kept-Latin tokens verified intact in the target: AI, UX, QA, diff, MR, PR, unicode, plus the C-/D-/T-/U- finding prefixes. None was translated or transliterated.
method.width: cell_len measurement per value against English (Devanagari combining marks counted as zero width): descriptions 0.81x-1.16x, i.e. none materially longer than its source (max: ux_reviewer 1.16x, reviewer 1.15x); install_to_edit 1.67x and installing 1.55x, measured, reported as H4.
method.second_pass: the 14 values were re-read once more after the first pass, focused on claim survival and negation (architect/reviewer/qa_tester/scout keep their negations). That pass produced H5 and confirmed H1-H4; no BLOCKER or MAJOR was withdrawn.
method.not_done: no rendered frame was captured in this audit: overflow, wrapping at 256 px and the header row are the design pass's evidence, not claimed here.

checked_and_accepted: लाइब्रेरी for the Library surface matches ui.library.* and ui.chat.directory.folder.library; लाइब्रेरी का ... is the same noun the rest of the locale uses.
मुद्दे for 'findings' matches ui.code_review.attention.findings; समीक्षा for review matches ui.code_review.
कार्यक्षेत्र (workspace) and एजेंट/टीम/ऑपरेटर follow i18n/glossary.md §2 and the existing hi corpus (ui.projects, ui.mesh).
इंस्टॉल for install matches ui.common.updates.* and ui.agents.detail.alert.builtin_body, so the button and the alert above it agree.

transliterated technical loans (कोडबेस, टूलसेट, व्यूपोर्ट, रिग, डिज़ाइन, कैटलॉग, फ़्रेम) follow the hi guide's loan policy (टोकन/डिवाइस precedent); रिग is opaque but the English 'rig' is equally opaque to a source reader, so the opacity is inherited from the source, not introduced.
no value is identical to its English source, and every value is a genuine Hindi rendering.
